entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. To see how I can best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a preference issue?
I think it's a fault. The heart rate readings are completely inaccurate. Frankly, the device feels like a piece of garbage. I saved up for this, and it just doesn't work. I'm so let down.
I can certainly understand your frustration. Sometimes a quick reset can fix sensor calibration. Would you be willing to try a few troubleshooting steps with me? It should only take a moment.

Honestly, I really don't have time for that. I'm not very technical and I've already lost faith in it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while and I just feel... let down. I just want my money back for a refund.
I hear you. I'm sorry this has been such a discouraging experience. And you're certain you'd prefer a return over trying to get it working?
Yes. I was counting on that money, and now it's tied up in this broken band. I just want money back in my account. I don't want a replacement or to spend an hour on the phone.

Okay, I understand completely. Let me pull up your order and check on the return eligibility for you. One moment please... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered just seven days ago.
That sounds right. I was so excited for it.

Alright, well, I have good news. Our company return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that window, I can absolutely process this for a full refund. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I was so worried I was going to be stuck with it.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, place it on the original packaging, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. Thank you again for your help.
Of course. Once we receive the device at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
